title: pm-dispatch: finding triage runs to empty each fire, quality held by ≤5-card same-family batches
body:
Closes #11972

Governed surface (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft, human merge. Verified at `a879b1e57`.

## The ruling

Scheduled finding triage no longer carries a per-round total budget. Every fire
grades **all** ungraded `finding` cards; the rubber-stamp risk is controlled by
batch granularity instead of by capping the round. Maintainer, 2026-08-25,
verbatim and untranslated:

> 单轮跑数小时没关系啊。不读卡的批量盖章 可以通过每批5张这种约定来解决

So: **≤5 same-family cards per batch, read one by one**, and a run of several
hours is an acceptable shape. A fire that exhausts its window resumes from where
it stopped — graded cards are off-label and never re-read, so the label
discipline already is the checkpoint.

## What changed

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, 「发现分诊轮」**
- `首触定级每轮跑:预算 3–5 张` → `每 fire 跑到清空`: no round total, all ungraded
  findings graded this round, first-touch still ahead of old-card re-verification.
- Quality clause added: `质量靠每批 ≤5 张同族卡逐张读,不靠封顶总量`, with the
  2026-08-25 ruling quoted verbatim at the point where the rule is stated.
- The `finding` >15 ⇒ 集中轮 trigger sentence is gone; 域分批 and the sweep
  promotion five rules stay, now as standing practice rather than a mode switch.
- Unchanged: 零定级评论优先, 判级在分诊不在立单, the skills-lane self-triage
  exception, the `Restart-when:` daily sub-round, `pm:retriage` per-fire priority.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`, 发现分诊轮细则**
- `自动集中轮批量参数:15–20 张` → `每批约定:≤5 张同族卡、同上下文逐张读`
  (维护者 2026-08-25,取代 15–20/批). Standing authorization unchanged.
- New `积压告警` bullet, the >15 trigger's destination: `连续 COMPLETED 清空 fire
  后仍 >15 ⇒ 入流 > 吞吐,报维护者。` With run-to-empty as the steady state a raw
  count is no longer a mode switch — it is only an alarm once it *survives*
  consecutive completed fires, which is precisely the test that separates inflow
  above triage capacity from a spike the next fire clears.
- `旧 hold 重验不占预算` removed — 「预算」 no longer exists; the ordering it
  encoded now reads `首触定级…优先于旧卡重验` in SKILL.md.
- Section heading provenance now reads 2026-08-13 / 08-25.

## Why run-to-empty rather than a larger budget

The current pile-up is an **outage** accumulation, not steady-state inflow.
Maintainer, 2026-08-25, verbatim and untranslated:

> 现在挤压这么多,是因为有一段时间我没token停了分诊,并且改成了两小时一次

That is the strongest argument for the ruled shape: a per-round budget never
recovers from an outage — it amortizes the backlog over dozens of fires while
new cards keep aging — whereas run-to-empty self-heals on the first fire after
supply returns. It is also why the alarm is calibrated on *survival across
completed fires*: an outage gap is expected to produce a spike and one long
recovery round, and that is by design, not an alarm.

This outage narrative is deliberately **not** copied into the runbook. Repo
convention for the ceilinged instruction surfaces is that provenance is one line
and stories live on cards, not in operational text — so the story stays here and
on the card's addendum, and the doc carries the rule it produced.

| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 274 | 274 | 274, headroom 0 |

The superseded prose is the purse: the 3–5 budget clause, the >15 trigger
sentence and the 15–20 batch parameter funded the ≤5 convention and the alarm
line. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` moves only to **lower** the
SKILL.md ceiling to the landed count — the shrink-only direction the ratchet
calls always legitimate. No registry entry was raised.

Every line stays within `MAX_LINE_BYTES=120`; the two verbatim rulings are
byte-intact, and no quote already spanning lines was re-flowed (the 出处
paragraph and the 状态转换机制 bullet are kept byte-identical).
